artifacts.summary: Research report establishing probe runtimes, the MinProbe parse error, the WitnessSearch2 timeout, and CslibTests promotion/registration mechanics
5-phase implementation plan promoting three witness probes into CslibTests/ with #guard_msgs assertions, barrel registration, and full CSLib CI gate

memory_candidates.content: When promoting a Lean scratch probe into CslibTests/, a `/-- ... -/` doc comment placed directly above a bare `#eval!` is a parse error in this repo's module-file dialect ("unexpected token '#eval!'; expected 'lemma'") because a declaration docstring must attach to a declaration. The CslibTests promotion idiom fixes this for free: `/-- info: <expected> -/` immediately followed by `#guard_msgs in` then plain `#eval` -- there the docstring is consumed by the #guard_msgs elaborator, not the docstring mechanism. Converting bare `#eval!` to this idiom simultaneously fixes the parse error and turns an unasserted printed value into a CI-protected build failure on drift. Use plain `#eval`, not `#eval!`, and namespace under `CslibTests.<Name>` so the topNamespace/dupNamespace linters pass.
